summary: Validated frontend bug fix in Quotes.jsx (L3432-3445): when loading a GATEWAY or LINK_PAGO quote for 'Modificar Cotización', the base concept 'Persona Jurídica' (Costo Base) is re-tagged with fixed:true so the count `pgMediosPagoCount = pgSetupItems.filter(i=>!i.fixed).length` excludes it. End-to-end UI validation passed for both quote types.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix at /app/frontend/src/pages/Quotes.jsx L3436-3440 is minimal and targeted: maps pg_setup_items on load and re-applies fixed:true to items where observacion==='Costo Base' OR concepto contains 'persona jur'. Both conditions provide redundancy in case legacy quotes lack one or the other identifier. Good defensive coding.

The fix only addresses the LOAD path. The root cause (the `fixed` flag being dropped when the quote is persisted) is NOT being fixed at the SAVE side — this means stored data in Mongo still has `fixed` missing on Persona Jurídica. This is acceptable because (a) the wizard re-tags on every load, and (b) the inflated `num_products` in already-saved quotes is a separate data backfill concern handled elsewhere. Recommend documenting that future code paths consuming pg_setup_items from Mongo should NOT rely on `fixed` and should use the 'Costo Base' / 'persona jur' heuristic, OR persist the flag on save (server-side, in /app/backend/routes/quotes.py) to make the data self-describing.

Pre-existing console hydration warnings observed (`<tr> cannot be a child of <span>` and `<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>`) — caused by `data-ve-dynamic` instrumentation wrappers around table rows. Cosmetic; not part of this bug but worth tracking.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing Borrador quotes only. The wizard was opened in 'Nueva Versión' mode, so closing the modal without saving leaves no persisted change.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-verify: login as admin → /quotes → click ⋮ (data-testid=quote-actions-{quote_id}) → 'Modificar Cotización' (modify-quote-btn-{quote_id}) → 'Nueva Versión' (modify-choice-new-version) → justificación >=20 chars (impl-justification-input) → 'Confirmar y Guardar' (impl-confirm-save-btn). Wizard opens with the existing PG/LP data. In Section 2, the table must show Persona Jurídica with a 'Fijo' badge and 'Costo Base' observation, followed by the medios de pago. In Section 3 the banner 'Medios de Pago seleccionados: N' MUST equal the number of actual medios de pago (NOT count Persona Jurídica). After clicking 'Generar Tabla de Recurrentes' (pg-generate-recurring-btn), the header reads 'Tabla calculada para N medio(s) de pago'.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: When a PG/LP quote was persisted, the `fixed:true` flag on the 'Persona Jurídica' (Costo Base) item was dropped by the backend serializer. On RE-OPEN via 'Modificar', the loader hydrated pgSetupItems without `fixed`, so the derived count `pgMediosPagoCount = pgSetupItems.filter(i=>!i.fixed).length` included Persona Jurídica as if it were a medio de pago, inflating `num_products` by +1 in the recurring-costs table. REPRO STEPS validated in this iteration: (1) Login as admin. (2) Modificar COT-2026-06-078-PYME (GATEWAY, Borrador, 4 medios+PJ): with fix, count = 4 (was 5 pre-fix). (3) Modificar COT-2026-06-155-PYME (LINK_PAGO, Borrador, 1 medio+PJ): with fix, count = 1 (was 2 pre-fix). MITIGATION applied: /app/frontend/src/pages/Quotes.jsx L3436-3440 re-tags base item as fixed:true on load. The recurring table is now generated for the correct number of products in both PG and LP modify flows.
